Anti-terror operation underway in Jammu and Kashmir's Shopian

Security forces have initiated a large-scale anti-terror operation in the Meemandar area of Shopian, Jammu and Kashmir. The operation was launched following credible intelligence about militant activity. A cordon and search process is currently in progress in the region.
